settings.title: Settings & Prompts
settings.description:
Configure AI conversation agents, prompts, and settings.

*Note: Custom prompts provided as-is without warranty - placeholder for question must remain present.*

data.fallback_agent: Fallback AI agent (used during outage/high demand)
data.primary_timeout: Time limit for the primary agent (seconds)
data.announce_model: Announce model name at the end of answers
data.enable_direct_query: Enable direct one-sentence query (without intermediate prompt)
data.direct_query_prefixes: Trigger prefixes for direct query (comma-separated, e.g. 'smart question, ai')
data.enable_ha_context: Provide Smart Home context to AI (weather, time, presence)
data.custom_knowledge: House Wiki & Family Facts (custom knowledge for the AI)
data.enable_detailed_followup: Offer follow-up question for deeper explanations
data.followup_prompt: Follow-up question prompt text (e.g. 'Yes or No?')
data.notify_target: Target device for mobile push (e.g. notify.notify or phone)
data.mobile_confirmation: Spoken confirmation when sending to smartphone
data.late_text: Announcement when the answer takes too long
data.retry_prompt: Prompt when question was not understood
data.abort_prompt: Abort announcement after second failed attempt
data.prompt_short: AI prompt for short answer (as-is, must include [question])
data.prompt_detailed: AI prompt for detailed explanation (as-is, use placeholders [question] and [previous_answer])

data_description.primary_timeout: If the primary agent has not answered by then, the fallback agent starts in parallel and the first valid answer wins. 0 = fallback agent only on an error.
data_description.answer_budget: If no agent has answered by then, Alexa says the text for slow answers and the answer follows as a push message to your phone. 0 = no time budget.

start_dialog.name: Start dialogue
start_dialog.description: Opens the AI voice question dialog on an Echo speaker.

echo_device.name: Target Echo device
echo_device.description: Echo media player (optional, defaults to last active Echo).

ask_question.name: Ask question
ask_question.description: Sends a question directly to the AI and speaks the answer on the Echo.

question.name: Question
question.description: The question to ask the AI.

echo_device.name: Target Echo device
echo_device.description: Echo media player (optional, defaults to last active Echo).

interactive_question.name: Ask interactive question
interactive_question.description: Asks an interactive question on Alexa and fires confirmation event on 'Yes' or 'No'.

echo_device.name: Target Echo device
echo_device.description: Echo media player (optional, defaults to last active Echo).

event_id.name: Event ID
event_id.description: Unique ID for the fired event in automations.
